method: Match runtime IDs through exact nearest-100 system provenance and CNS5 provenance.
Group CNS5 entries with NComp >= 2 by primary GJ pointer, falling back to their own GJ number; merge overlapping source groups.
Compare source groups to the current suffix-derived and explicit five-system card associations.
Defer missing, compound, conflicting labels and non-curated spectroscopic-binary records for individual review.
Inspect remaining ungrouped runtime records for CNS5 multiplicity or frozen SIMBAD SB* flags; do not infer membership from sky proximity.
limitations: Association candidates have usable frozen-source labels, not a guarantee of complete physical membership or current individual-component measurements.
SIMBAD SB* flags are review triggers; they do not by themselves establish extra component identities.
SIMBAD ** can denote a multiple-star object and is not sufficient proof that a source row is an unresolved aggregate. The generator currently excludes this type.
The isolated-record count includes both Fomalhaut A and B and must not be interpreted as a count of distinct systems.
Only the three base catalogs were reviewed; optional overlays are outside scope.
